meta_description: KCD Plastering delivers expert plastering across Birmingham. Internal renders, skimming, repairs and new builds. Call 07861 436444 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to full room skimming, we deliver smooth, professional finishes that last. Free quotes, no mess left behind.
services_subhead: Whether you need internal renders, wall repairs, or full skimming work, we handle every project with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, professional skim finishes for new plasterboard or existing walls. We deliver perfectly flat surfaces ready for paint or wallpaper.

services.title: External Renders
services.desc: Durable cement and silicone renders that protect your exterior and enhance kerb appeal. Finished to a high standard and built to last.

services.title: Textured Coatings
services.desc: Polished plaster, Venetian finishes, and decorative coatings for feature walls. Bespoke effects tailored to your design vision.

services.title: Wall & Ceiling Repairs
services.desc: Cracked plaster, damp damage, and impact repairs made invisible. We match existing finishes so repairs blend seamlessly.

services.title: New Build Plastering
services.desc: Full plastering packages for new construction and extensions. Efficient scheduling and quality control from first coat to final finish.

services.title: Damp-Proof Remedial Work
services.desc: Specialist plaster systems for damp walls and moisture-prone areas. We use breathable finishes to prevent future problems.

about_pullquote: We take pride in leaving sites clean and finished right, every single time.
about_para_1: KCD Plastering was established over a decade ago to bring reliable, honest plastering to Birmingham homes and businesses. We've built our reputation by showing up on time, delivering flawless finishes, and treating every property as if it were our own. Whether you're dealing with a single cracked wall or a full renovation project, we bring the same level of care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because they know what they're getting: no cutting corners, no hidden charges, and work that's built to last. We specialise in awkward repairs and complex renders that other plasterers turn down, and we pride ourselves on solving problems, not just covering them up. Hundreds of Birmingham homes trust KCD — and once you've worked with us, you'll call us back.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About KCD

reviews.text: Had a huge crack running down our hallway wall, and KCD sorted it in a morning. The skim finish is absolutely perfect — you'd never know there was ever any damage. Tidy lads, fair price, would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Got quotes from three plasterers and KCD came in competitive and got us booked in within a week. Did the whole front room skim, and the quality is brilliant. No mess, professional job from start to finish.
reviews.author: Paula H.

reviews.text: Called them up on Friday for an emergency damp plaster issue, and they were here Saturday morning. Fixed it properly with a breathable finish. Really helpful lads, and no daft call-out charge. Top service.
reviews.author: David R.
